<article class="entry"><div class="entry-date">2026</div><div class="entry-body"><h4>American Statistical Association – 2026 Award Recognition</h4><p class="meta"><strong>Award:</strong> <em>Norman Beery Memorial Scholarship – 2026</em></p><p>Featured among ASA award recipients and selected for the Norman Beery Memorial Scholarship, which supports first-generation college students pursuing studies in statistics.</p><p><a href="https://magazine.amstat.org/blog/2026/06/01/2026-awards/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ASA News – 2026 Awardees</a> · <a href="https://www.amstat.org/your-career/awards/norman-beery-memorial-scholarship" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Norman Beery Memorial Scholarship</a></p></div></article>
<article class="entry"><div class="entry-date">2025</div><div class="entry-body"><h4>American Statistical Association – Giving Newsletter, Fall 2025</h4><p class="meta"><strong>Feature:</strong> ASA Giving Newsletter: Fall 2025</p><p>Featured for sharing my experience at the 2025 Joint Statistical Meetings (JSM) and highlighting the impact of the ASA Student and Early Career Travel Fund in supporting student participation and professional development.</p><p><a href="https://www.amstat.org/docs/default-source/amstat-documents/ASAGiving-NewsletterFall2025.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ASA Giving Newsletter – Fall 2025</a></p></div></article>

Curtin Award – 2025</em></p><p>Featured among ASA award recipients recognized for contributions and promise in the field of statistics.</p><p><a href="https://magazine.amstat.org/blog/2025/06/02/awardees/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ASA News – 2025 Awardees</a></p></div></article>
<article class="entry"><div class="entry-date">2025</div><div class="entry-body"><h4>Statistics in Pharmaceuticals Scholarship Award, 2025</h4><p class="meta"><strong>Institution:</strong> University of Connecticut</p><p>Selected for scholarship support to participate in professional development and training focused on pharmaceutical statistics and applications in drug development.</p><p><a href="https://stat4pharma.org/events/sip2025/scholarship.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">SIP Scholarship</a></p></div></article>
<article class="entry"><div class="entry-date">2025</div><div class="entry-body"><h4>University of New Mexico Outstanding Student Recognition, 2025</h4><p class="meta"><strong>Awards:</strong> <em>Excellence in Teaching – 2025</em>; <em>Student of the Year – 2025</em></p><p>Honored by the University of New Mexico for contributions to teaching, student engagement, leadership, and service.</p><p><a href="https://www.instagram.com/unmafro/p/DJKe6LWvQJe/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">UNM Recognition</a></p></div></article>
